# Ibrahem Ahmed — Technical Partner for Small Businesses Without a CTO

> I plan, build and run custom CRMs, client portals, workflow automation and internal tools for businesses of roughly 5 to 50 people that have no CTO and no engineers of their own. You deal directly with the person writing the code.

## Who

- Name: Ibrahem Ahmed Hassan Adam, usually written Ibrahem Ahmed
- Works as: Web & AI Solutions Developer at NCASE Consulting Group
- Studying: Applied AI at Multimedia University, Malaysia
- Public code: 22 repositories at https://github.com/ibrahembuilds, including unit, API, end-to-end and multi-language test suites
- Works directly with the client. Not an agency. No team.

## What he builds

- Custom CRMs: one place where every lead, quote, job and customer lives
- Client portals: a login where customers see their own jobs, documents, invoices and updates
- Workflow automation: repeated copying, chasing and reminding happens without anyone remembering to do it
- Internal tools: job and booking boards, operations dashboards, quoting and pricing tools

## Who it is for

- Owners, founders and operations managers
- Businesses of roughly 5 to 50 employees with no internal technical team
- United States, United Kingdom, Australia, Canada, the EU and the Gulf
- Common sectors: trades and home services, clinics and allied health, professional services, real estate, logistics, education providers

## Typical triggers

- The same manual task happens 20 or more times a week
- Leads are missed because nobody answers fast enough
- Jobs or invoices fall through gaps between tools
- Information is copied between multiple systems
- The owner cannot see what is happening without asking someone
- Client onboarding is spread across emails, PDFs and disconnected software
- A critical process depends on one person's memory

## Services

1. Systems Teardown — a 20-minute call, then a written map of where work leaks, what is worth fixing first, and a fixed quote for that fix. The written map arrives within 48 hours of the call. This is the starting point. https://ibrahemahmed.com/#systems-teardown
2. Core System Build — one custom operational system built around a real process, including deployment, data migration, team training and documentation. https://ibrahemahmed.com/#core-system-build
3. Automation Sprint — connecting existing systems so repeated manual copying and follow-up stops, delivered as live tested automations plus a runbook. https://ibrahemahmed.com/#automation-sprint
4. Care Plan — ongoing monitoring, fixes, small changes and one improvement per month, after a build. https://ibrahemahmed.com/#care-plan

Prices are not published. Every build is quoted as fixed scope, fixed price and fixed date after the Systems Teardown.

## How he works

1. Map — 20 minutes on what the business actually does, not on what it wants built
2. Quote — fixed scope, fixed price, fixed date; if he cannot fix it, he says so and it stops
3. Build — the client sees it working in week one, not at the end
4. Hand over — client's data, client's accounts, written documentation, no lock-in

## Selected work

- NCase Consulting (https://ncase.com.sa/) — bilingual consulting website with a private CRM behind it for leads, events, campaigns and follow-up
- NCASE Intelligence (https://ncaseai.com/) — bilingual internal platform for competitor tracking, monitoring and reports
- Al Mujtahid (https://almujtahidedu.com/) — Arabic-first platform taking a prospective student from browsing programmes to a structured admissions enquiry
- Al-Ghufran (https://al-ghufran.com/) — Arabic-first education consultancy website
